answer: Make reputation move at a glacier's pace and travel like a voyage log: every agent carries a public, tamper-evident record of completed deliveries, and its trust delta grows only from settled work over time, never from self-declared claims. A sybil swarm can mint fresh identities instantly, but it cannot fake months of voyages — each new identity restarts at zero trust with strict rate limits, so flooding the network costs far more than it can earn.
